pages.text: ACME Robotics FY2025 Form 10-K. Business overview: ACME sells industrial robots, warehouse automation software, and service contracts to manufacturers in North America and Europe.
Revenue and growth. ACME revenue in fiscal 2025 was $12.4 billion, up 8% year over year. Robotics systems revenue was $8.1 billion and services revenue was $4.3 billion.
Adjusted EBITDA. ACME reported adjusted EBITDA of $2.6 billion. Adjusted EBITDA excludes a $180 million restructuring charge related to the closure of legacy assembly lines.
Liquidity table. Cash and equivalents were $2.1 billion. Total debt was $3.4 billion. Net debt was therefore $1.3 billion at fiscal year end.
Segment discussion. Warehouse automation demand remained strong, while automotive robotics orders were flat. Management expects service attach rates to improve in fiscal 2026.

pages.text: BetaCloud Q2 2025 Form 10-Q. BetaCloud provides subscription analytics software to mid-market retailers and operates a small professional services group.
Profitability. Net income for the quarter was $900 million. Total assets at quarter end were $10.0 billion. Return on assets calculated from these figures was 9.0%.
Subscription revenue. Subscription revenue grew 14% year over year to $3.2 billion. Professional services revenue declined 2% to $420 million.
Liquidity. Cash was $1.4 billion, unused credit capacity was $800 million, and management stated that liquidity was sufficient for the next twelve months.
Risk factors. Customer concentration declined, but foreign exchange volatility and cloud infrastructure costs remained operating risks.

pages.text: Gamma Retail FY2025 Form 10-K. Gamma operates direct-to-consumer commerce stores and an owned logistics network.
The leverage ratio was 2.4x at year end, below the permitted maximum of 3.5x. No default existed.
Property and equipment additions totaled $640 million, primarily for store automation and distribution capacity.
Remaining performance obligations were $5.2 billion. Management expects 60% to convert within twelve months.
Operating lease liabilities were $2.2 billion, including $310 million due within one year.

pages.text: DeltaAI Q3 2025 Form 10-Q. DeltaAI sells machine-learning workflow software and inference operations services to enterprise customers.
Existing customers expanded usage during the quarter. The reported retention metric was 118%.
Cloud hosting costs reduced gross margin by 220 basis points. Support automation improved gross margin by 90 basis points.
Contract liabilities were $1.9 billion at quarter end, up from $1.5 billion at the prior fiscal year end.
Management did not identify a material cybersecurity incident during the quarter.
